structure.unit: Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act

law.catch_line: Cooperation between courts; preservation of records

text.section: Upon request of a court of another state, a court of this Commonwealth may hold a hearing or enter an order described in subsection A.
Travel and other necessary and reasonable expenses incurred under subsections A and B may be assessed against the parties according to the law of this Commonwealth.

A court of this Commonwealth shall preserve the pleadings, orders, decrees, records of hearings, evaluations, and other pertinent records with respect to a child custody proceeding until the child attains eighteen years of age. Upon appropriate request by a court or law-enforcement official of another state, the court shall forward a certified copy of those records.
